mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workbench_generated_test_cases ( organization_uuid, values, created_at ) VALUES ( #{organizationUUID}, CAST(#{valuesJSON,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT uuid, CAST(values AS text) AS values_json FROM workbench_generated_test_cases WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} ORDER BY created_at ASC, uuid ASC FOR UPDATE
